definitions.gloss: to project, to display (on a screen or surface)
definitions.explanation: To show an image, video, or visual content on a screen, wall, or other surface using a projector, camera, or similar device.

definitions.gloss: to reflect, to reveal, to portray
definitions.explanation: To make something visible or apparent; to depict or represent a situation, emotion, or reality. Used figuratively for media, art, or observation.

notes:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), す-ending.
- Negative: {映|うつ}し{出|だ}さない
- Polite: {映|うつ}し{出|だ}します
- Te-form: {映|うつ}し{出|だ}して
- Past: {映|うつ}し{出|だ}した

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{映|うつ}し{出|だ}す: to project footage
- ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{映|うつ}し{出|だ}す: to reflect/portray reality

USAGE:
The compound structure ⟦{映|うつ}す→映す：12963_utsusu⟧ + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ combines "to project/reflect" with "to bring out," emphasizing that something is made visible or brought to light.
